dct_description_sm: Since 2012, this case has been played 2101 times.

A demo of Certainty-Based Marking, aka Confidence-Based Marking. 
In node 14585 in the Fourth phase certainty-last arm, we further introduce the concept of post-post-hoc certainty: what happens if you show the user where they lie on the scale, compared to their peers. Does this weaken or confirm their confidence in their response?
